page.notes: Page is a numbered page with no printed page number visible. Text in the centre is partly overprinted by show-through from the reverse side (mirrored lines), which was ignored. "vz." in the chapter heading is uncertain. Section numbers were placed as marginal notes beside their lines; the §. 7 and §. 13 marks stand at the left margin.
